selected.title: Rain applies to establish national trust bank
selected.summary: Rain, the enterprise-grade infrastructure for stablecoin payments, announced today that it has filed an application with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish Rain National Trust Bank (RNTB), a proposed national trust bank headquartered in New York.
selected.why: Fintech firm Rain applies for a national trust bank charter with the OCC.

reason: Rain's trust charter application raises arguable questions about whether stablecoin infrastructure firms need bank regulation or whether OCC oversight creates inappropriate barriers to payment innovation.
angle: Stablecoin payment infrastructure should not require national bank charters; doing so imposes legacy banking regulation on non-deposit-taking platforms.
